items.name: uacc
items.description: Universal AI Computer Control. Mouse, keyboard, screenshot, OCR via MCP. pip install uacc then uacc-mcp.
items.install_hint: pip install uacc ; uacc-mcp. Cortex probe: computer_control.status. Arm with CORTEX_COMPUTER_CONTROL=1.
